case_title: GOMEZ, ERNESTO VS STOLLER, ROD IND/DBA ICE CREAM DISTRIBUTOR

docket_entries.description: AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,500.00 FILED BY GOMEZ, ERNESTO AS TO DEFENDANT STOLLER, ROD IND/DBA ICE CREAM DISTRIBUTOR ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAY-07-2003 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF GOMEZ, ERNESTO RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT STOLLER, ROD IND/DBA ICE CREAM DISTRIBUTOR $1,850.00 PRINCIPAL, $22.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,872.00, DEFENDANT JIM COLEMAN IS DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
